faq.q: Do I have to create an account to use it?
faq.a: No. The released Android, HarmonyOS and web apps let you record pantry items and shopping lists without an account. Features differ by platform; registration and cloud sync are not available.

faq.q: Does it work without a network?
faq.a: Local pantry and shopping features work offline on Android and HarmonyOS. The web app needs a connection on first use and must finish caching before it can open offline; it has no background notifications. See the iOS preview for local meal features. Remote AI is not available.

Photo recognition is part of the unreleased iOS version and runs locally with Apple Vision. Check names, quantities and dates before saving, and edit when needed. Android, HarmonyOS and the web app currently use manual entry, without this recognition feature or retail barcode lookup.

faq.q: Will AI change my pantry on its own?
faq.a: No. AI only recognizes and suggests; it never changes your pantry directly. Recognition results, meal plans and shopping changes all take effect only after you confirm them.

faq.q: Can I fully trust expiry dates and nutrition info?
faq.a: No. Dates and nutrition come from your entry, packaging or recognition — they’re management references. Check packaging labels, storage conditions and official recall notices. Normal appearance or smell does not guarantee food safety.

faq.q: Will FreshLife gradually learn my family’s habits?
faq.a: Local preferences are different from cross-device household memory. Android 1.0.2 includes local household settings and usage estimates based on confirmed records; iOS capabilities depend on its version. Full cloud household memory is not available, and the app does not place orders automatically. Any future online service will explain its data use and request the necessary consent before launch.

faq.q: How do I export or delete my data?
faq.a: Choose your platform in the Help Center for the correct export and deletion steps. Android and HarmonyOS use local backups, and web exports are saved where you choose. Backup files are not guaranteed to work across platforms. Export before clearing data or changing devices, and manage exported files separately.
